notes: Draft configuration: The manufacturer identifies the 5.6 km Alfa Romeo course at Balocco in its 2019 release. The independently mapped full Northern sweep, two straight chicanes, Eastern technical return, underpass and complete Southern terminal hairpin identify this configuration. The Southern return follows the continuous outside curve rather than the two nearby angular training connections. The selected public OSM centerline is 5590 m against the 5591 m catalogue distance; neither the high-speed oval nor Langhe loop is substituted. All vertices remain exact pinned OSM nodes; course direction and historical corner alignment remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 5590.0 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
